# Precision

Make the person feel capable and in control, with useful information and actions immediately within reach.

Create beauty through exact alignment, precise typography, readable comparisons, and clear visual states. Let density follow the work: keep related evidence visible together and use space to distinguish groups and decisions. Give important values, units, and differences a strong hierarchy.

Make the effect of an action legible. Use motion to explain a change or preserve orientation, and keep context stable while details update. Put definitions and uncertainty beside the information they qualify. Let the character come from well-composed information and responsive behavior.
